method: Two components per country and year (USD m, converted at ECB annual averages): N = groups not exited, X = KSE exited cohort. N 2021/2023 = B4U23 per-country profit tax (22 countries, excl. exited); all other countries allocated from a residual using leave-russia.org non-exited counts and IMF counterpart-derived FDI stock (geometric mean of the two keys), calibrated on the B4U23 EU residual (EU non-exited ~USD 2.3bn minus listed EU 2,259m) and capped below the chart cut-off. X 2021/2023 = KSE total profit tax minus all N, split by exited-cohort revenue (KSE Fig.4 revenue incl. exited minus B4U23 revenue excl. exited) and, for other countries, exited counts. 2022 = mean of interpolated 2021/2023 shares and B4U22 shares (preliminary 2.9bn base) applied to KSE80 2022 totals. 2024 = B4U24 per-country (all statuses) for 15 countries, remainder (USD 655m) split EU (~83m: EU 2.64bn minus listed) / non-EU with caps (EU < 50m, non-EU < 123m). 2025 = 2024 shares x KSE80 2025 preliminary totals. In-scope tax = N + f*X, f = time-weighted share of the exited cohort still foreign-owned (2022 0.8, 2023 0.45, 2024 0.25, 2025 0.1; ranges 0.65-0.9, 0.3-0.6, 0.1-0.35, 0.02-0.15). All taxes (profit, VAT, payroll, property, excise, customs, exit taxes) = mean of (country profit-tax share x KSE all-tax total) and (country revenue share x total; revenue from KSE Fig.4 for 15 countries) times the in-scope ratio. 90% intervals: log-normal, sd from method spread, key spread and total uncertainty.

totals.note: profit_tax / all_taxes = taxes paid by Russian subsidiaries while foreign-owned (scope of this file). *_kse_all_statuses = KSE headline totals, which also include, for 2022-2025, taxes of subsidiaries already sold to Russian owners (KSE "exited" cohort of 565 groups). Totals ranges are computed on the totals, not by adding country bounds.
